failure_summary.description: Promoted a regularity guarantee for every exponent below μ to the unproved endpoint exponent μ.
Confused finiteness onto an image with point separation when deciding which geometric condition supports rational descent.

patch.reasoning: Both errors came from ranking statements by how strong or comprehensive they sounded instead of checking the exact implication. Add targeted checks for endpoint regularity and for the distinction between finite fibers and a unique preimage.

edits.content:
## Endpoint Regularity
A guarantee for some or every `0 < λ < μ` does not include `λ = μ`. Do not promote a Hölder exponent to its endpoint unless the result explicitly permits it; endpoint regularity can fail even when all lower exponents hold.

## Geometric Conditions and Fibers
Compare map hypotheses by their actual consequences, not by which sounds more substantial. A morphism finite onto its image may have multiple points in a fiber; finiteness alone does not make a local preimage of a rational image point a rational point. When a conclusion requires rational descent from the image, check whether the hypothesis ensures a unique geometric preimage or whether an additional argument is supplied. Do not conflate generic injectivity, finiteness, and separation of points.
